name: 28451 · Leland, NC
findings: ZIP 28451 (Leland) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28451 (Leland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
